description: NOTE: As of May 4, 2026, the Respondent First Name, Respondent Address (Street Name), Respondent Address (City), and Respondent Address (State Name) fields have been removed from this dataset. All other fields and records remain searchable, or as an alternative, use the OATH Summons Finder or a summons lookup tool from the issuing agency. You can share any questions you have about this change by entering them in the form on nyc.gov/askopendata. The OATH Hearings Division Case Status dataset contains information about alleged public safety and quality of life violations that are filed and adjudicated through the City’s administrative law court, the NYC Office of Administrative Trials and Hearings (OATH) and provides information about the infraction charged, decision outcome, payments, amounts and fees relating to the case. The summonses listed in this dataset are issued and filed at the OATH Hearings Division by City enforcement agencies.
